title: Create a room
summary: Each room (or chair) is a column on the calendar. It belongs to a branch.

inputs.name: Room name (e.g. Room 1)
inputs.sede: Name of the branch it belongs to

steps.title: Room name
steps.details: Each room is a column on the calendar. A short name ("Room 1", "Chair A") reads better.

steps.title: Branch
steps.details: Required: the room is only offered during its branch's hours.
steps.description: Choose which branch this room is in.

steps.title: Color on the calendar
steps.details: Visual only: helps tell the rooms apart on the calendar.
steps.description: Helps tell the rooms apart at a glance.

steps.title: Create the room
steps.details: Creates the room as active. Later you can choose which doctors use it in the access tab.
